text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Make Debut. In board game terms, it's 
the crucial opening move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete. The strategy is 
rock-solid. However...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I know, I know... I knooow, okay?... 
But still, somehow, you know...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
While thinking about all sorts of things, 
I started losing my motivation...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, the strategy is flawless...! Hold 
back on the inside, then swing out wide at 
the end and overtake! With this...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? Are there like five people lined 
up right next to me?! This is basically a 
wall...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, Let me out, let me out, let me 
goooo! You've completely ruined 
everythinggg~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLING)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A-A dream...? But... when I think about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It could totally happen... Just dragging 
things out without ever getting to race... 
God, how pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. When I dropped by the 
school the other day, too...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, this weekend— you're finally making 
your debut.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for allowing us to 
report on your prestigious academy today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Rulership-san, how do you like your 
chances? Are you feeling like the Debut 
Race is going to be a walk in the park?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Remembering stuff like that just kinda 
makes me feel... yeah."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'd love to go, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a giant door is blocking my 
path. Like a psychological barrier or 
something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, what stands before an Umamusume 
is her rivals. But in Rulership's case...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Still, this one's a pretty 
tough opponent...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—one hour later.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... I'm here. I somehow managed 
to step out of my comfort zone...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*, *wheeze*, *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... going outside consumed quite a lot 
of my MP...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In return, the race might be a bit 
tougher, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A negative is certainly a negative. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have one promising factor I've prepared 
in advance.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: 2000m... Yeah, that's right. That was it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A race doesn't begin on the day of 
the race itself. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It started a long time ago. And that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you in this Debut race. My 
memorable opening move shall be—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've already set it in motion! Behold my 
If-Then planning.
